$comment: Felling (docs/FELLING.md §5): what loses its support falls as a body, tips and settles back into blocks. riderReach: how far (cells, through leaves) a leaf belongs to the log nearest it (20 since 0.71's giants, whose leaves reach 17 cells from their wood: at 6 a felled giant left the rest hanging, BUGS.md #193; dwell-sim tests/leaf_reach.rs checks every species against it). maxSystemCells: the most logs and leaves one support search looks at (a larger tree stands). maxPieceCells: the most cells one falling piece may have. toppleSpin: the spin (rad/s) a piece cut by a player starts with, tipping it away from them about its foot; toppleTipSpeed: at most this fast (m/s) at its farthest point, so a tall trunk is nudged, not flung. cutTip: a trunk let go by breaking the log under it through block damage (an axe's hits) tips toward the side of that log which lost the most material (its hits' marks, the side its damage mask took out: a real notch; docs/BLOCK_DAMAGE.md §16), at this share of the topple spin and tip speed (owner, 2026-11-15: "Trees should get the force applied to them like it used to be so they fall again"). sleepLinear / sleepAngular / restDrift: a piece slower than these (m/s, rad/s), or that has not gone farther than restDrift (m, at its farthest point) since it began counting (jostled in a heap of pieces, rocked by water), for sleepSeconds settles; the pieces due settle together every settleEveryTicks server ticks (60 a second): one modification and one terrain-collision rebuild a chunk for all that settle then, not one each tick. maxSeconds: a piece still moving after this settles where it is. maxSettles: a piece that has settled this many times stays where it settles, anchored or not (1: what lands falls no further; owner, 2026-11-02). beachSeconds: a piece that was afloat, of a body kind that doesn't settle afloat (bodies.json `settlesAfloat`), settles only once it has been out of the water this long (beached), its sleep and maxSeconds counted from then; afloat it drifts with the current (owner, 2026-11-12: floating trees "should never settle, it causes them to block up rivers"). hitSpeed: a piece hitting a player faster than this (m/s, its speed toward them) hurts, hitDamagePerSpeed points per m/s over it. holdSpeed: a piece slower than this (m/s, at any point) is held from players' contacts and moved by their push instead (the controller's maxPushForce over its mass a tick, toward their speed into it; the clients predict the same: docs/BUILT_BODIES.md §6, owner 2026-11-02); faster, it moves as the physics says (held fast, a falling piece would squeeze players through the ground). pushHoldSeconds: a pushed piece stays held this long after its last push, however fast. settleGlideSeconds: how long (s) a settling piece is drawn gliding from where it rests into its blocks' places (and a cell moved at settling, from where it would have gone), on the clients only. settleBounce: how far past its place (a fraction of the glide) it swings before it rests. terrainChunksPerTick: the most terrain-collision chunks the server builds a tick round falling pieces (their bounds, nearest first): a long piece's ground loads over a few ticks rather than stalling one. Run `node shared/physics/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-sim/src/felling.gen.rs is stale.
